structured_output.rationale: All 18 react/no-unstable-nested-components findings in src/components were fixed by hoisting component-shaped functions out of parent renders, not by suppression. Verified: check 1 printed 0; check 2 printed 132 (down from 150); npm run type passed (after npm run plugins:build, as CI does, on Node 24.16.0); the literal test command matched source paths so jest found no tests, so the corresponding suites (ChartContextMenu, DrillByModal, DrillBySubmenu, ChangeDatasourceModal, DatasourceEditor tests, PanelToolbar) were run: 7 suites / 71 tests passed. behavior_change is true in one narrow, user-observable sense: DrillBySubmenu previously defined its react-window Row component inside render, so every parent render remounted all visible rows (losing row-level state/focus); hoisting it to module scope with handleSelection passed via itemData removes those remounts. Rendered output is otherwise identical. All other sites (CollectionTable itemRenderers, TableCollection Cell renderers, antd dropdownRender/popupRender/itemRender) invoke the functions as plain calls, so hoisting them is behaviour-neutral. Type-only corrections: ChangeDatasourceModal now uses SelectedDataset = Dataset & { type: string } instead of the inaccurate Datasource type (uid was never read) and drops two `any` cell props; DatasourceEditor's Metric interface gained the optional is_certified field it was already read through.

## Definition of done

Run these yourself and confirm each one before opening a pull request. All paths
are relative to `superset-frontend/`. Use the lockfile-pinned binary at
`./node_modules/.bin/oxlint`, **not** `npx` -- npx may resolve a different
version than the lockfile and give you a different answer than CI.

```bash
cd superset-frontend

# 1. This area is clean.
./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --config oxlint.json -A all -D react/no-unstable-nested-components --format json \
  | jq '[.diagnostics[] | select(.filename | startswith("src/components/"))] | length'
# must print 0

# 2. Nothing else regressed. The repo-wide count for this rule must be exactly
#    132, down from 150. Higher means you broke something; lower means
#    you changed files outside the scope of this task.
./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --config oxlint.json -A all -D react/no-unstable-nested-components --format json \
  | jq '.diagnostics | length'

# 3. Types still check.
npm run type

# 4. Tests still pass for what you touched.
npm run test -- src/components/Chart/ChartContextMenu/ChartContextMenu.tsx src/components/Chart/DrillBy/DrillByModal.tsx src/components/Chart/DrillBy/DrillBySubmenu.tsx src/components/Datasource/ChangeDatasourceModal/index.tsx src/components/Datasource/components/DatasourceEditor/DatasourceEditor.tsx src/components/PanelToolbar/index.tsx
```

## Constraints

- Do not suppress the rule. Suppression is a failed session, not a fix.
- Fix the cause, not the symptom.
- Do not modify `oxlint.json`, and do not add any lint-disable or `@ts-ignore`
  comment. Changing the rule's configuration is a failed session, not a fix.
- Do not touch files outside `src/components`.
- If a correct fix requires changing runtime behaviour, make the change and state
  it explicitly in the pull request body. Do not hide it.
- **If you cannot fix something correctly, stop and explain why.** A blocked
  session is a valid, expected outcome and a human will review it. A fix that
  passes the linter while preserving the defect is not a valid outcome.

## Pull request

Open a PR against `master` of `CognitionTakeHomeOrg/superset-adham-clone`. Follow `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
and Conventional Commits, e.g. `fix(components): add stable keys to error message lists`.
State in the body which of the four checks above you ran and what they printed.

if check 1 actually printed 0 when you ran it.
